evidence: The hosted WAIT path is reachable in production and emits nothing. review_local.run() (tools/pr-approval-agent/review_local.py:338-351) sets final_verdict=WAIT and returns pipeline.to_dict() with no _capture_review_completed call; the file has zero call sites of that method, and the only captures the hosted path gets are the ones folded into Pipeline methods it happens to call: _refuse_bot_author (review_pr.py:297, 'DENIED'/'BOT-AUTHOR') and _llm_review (review_pr.py:804). The Action's equivalent block _handle_in_flight_bot_reviews captures ('SKIPPED','WAIT') at review_pr.py:353, so the two runtimes diverge on exactly this outcome. Reachability: the server waits out trusted reviewer bots for STAMPHOG_BOT_REVIEW_MAX_POLLS*POLL_SECONDS = ~300s (products/stamphog/backend/temporal/constants.py:39-40, workflow.py:82-96), refreshing the reactions snapshot via list_in_flight_reviewer_bots (activities.py:337-374); when the budget expires the sandbox runs anyway and the engine's _in_flight_bot_reviewers (review_pr.py:300-310) still sees the eyes because BOT_EYES_MAX_AGE is 45 min (constants.py:38). greptile-apps[bot] is in both trusted lists (constants.py:29-37, github.py:70-76) and reviews PostHog/posthog, where self-driving PRs land; ReviewHog is not a trusted reactor and posts no eyes reaction (no matches in products/review_hog/backend), so it cannot cause it, but Greptile can. The server then parses 'WAIT' to 'wait' (products/stamphog/backend/logic/reviewer.py:32) and post_verdict persists run.status=COMPLETED, run.verdict=wait and posts a sticky comment (activities.py:757-762), so the outcome is recorded in Postgres but never in the event stream. Consumers exist: the dogfood project has 25 saved insights on stamphog_review_completed, including the self-driving rollout dashboard (1922705) where 'stamped' means a stamphog_review_completed event with stamphog_self_driving_review=true (insights uI8bElym and CkKvE05A, HogQL subselect), mhbAJ7QF ('every verdict counted', filtered on that same property), and the verdict-mix breakdowns on stamphog_final_verdict (3npbW5KZ, KiXFEtsJ) that show Action WAITs but can never show hosted ones. Server code states the intent that hosted outcomes be visible next to completed events: mark_review_failed captures stamphog_review_failed 'so the dashboards see hosted breakage next to the review-completed events' (activities.py:859-877). The plumbing for the fix already exists in the sandbox: POSTHOG_API_KEY/POSTHOG_HOST are forwarded (activities.py:164-167), STAMPHOG_EXTRA_PROPERTIES stamps stamphog_runtime=hosted plus stamphog_self_driving_review (activities.py:168-176, gateway.py:17-32), and review_local.main() flushes (review_local.py:404). PR scope: the GitHub API patch for review_local.py is +7/-2 and touches only the self_driving kwarg and the refusal guard at line 324, so the capture-less WAIT block predates this PR and already affects human-authored hosted PRs; but for the population this PR targets, the change moves self-driving bot PRs from 'always emits an event' (BOT-AUTHOR refusal) to 'sometimes emits nothing', and the dashboard built for that rollout is the consumer. Severity is should_fix rather than must_fix because no product behaviour reads the event: label handling, retries, supersession, and resolution all key off ReviewRun (activities.py:708-780), so the gap is monitoring parity, not correctness.
notes: I would downgrade to consider if the self-driving dashboards switched their 'stamped' signal to the synced ReviewRun table (verdict includes wait) instead of the event, or if a review_local.run() test showed WAIT is unreachable in hosted runs (for example the server refusing to provision while a trusted bot is still in flight). I would upgrade to must_fix if any server-side follow-up (re-trigger, label strip, inbox status) were found to key off stamphog_review_completed rather than ReviewRun.
